_comment: BugWolf hooks (plan v2 4.4/5.2 + master plan Phase 3, complete v1.22): SessionStart -> cockpit (scope/sandbox/leads/mode/target-model freshness + learned instincts v1.24) + harness_guard verify (cached); UserPromptSubmit -> mission-context injection + stale-model warning (3.2); PreToolUse -> harness-level scope enforcement (denies out-of-scope Bash/WebFetch while a mission contract exists; inert otherwise); PostToolUse -> auto-capture HTTP-ish outputs into the hash-chained evidence ledger with replay_key (3.3); Stop -> persistent-mode freeze; PreCompact -> cockpit digest persist (v1.24, ECC memory-persistence pattern).
